mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges in matching stucco color?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in stucco color matching include the natural fading and discoloration of existing stucco due to age and environmental exposure, making an exact match difficult. Texture differences also play a role, as the same color can appear different on varied textures. The presence of multiple stucco layers or previous repair attempts can add complexity. Achieving consistency across large areas and accounting for changing light conditions further complicates the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges in stucco color matching include fading of old stucco, texture differences, previous repair attempts, and ensuring consistency across large areas and varying light.
